title: Sentiment Alerts
description: Alert supervisors when call sentiment drops below 30% within 60 seconds, configurable per team.
acceptance_criteria: Alert is raised within 5 seconds of sentiment below 30%
Supervisor can set the threshold per team (10-90%)
Alert is not raised for calls shorter than 20 seconds
success_metrics: 80% of alerts acted on within 2 minutes (baseline measured in sprint 1)
